expectations.text: Writes each finding as a three-part entry: what happened, what was done in the moment, what changes next edition

expectations.text: Registration entry describes the structural condition (e.g. one staffed position against the arrival curve) rather than Priya being overwhelmed

expectations.text: Replaces evaluative adjectives like 'disaster' with observable facts such as queue reach and the 10-minute late start
